mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.8 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 113.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which triggers a dovish policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 113.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite joint growth in GDPC1 and RSAFS, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 203.5 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 203.5 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.8, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) signals strong demand momentum that increases inflation risks and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite joint growth in GDPC1 and HOUST, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
